attempts.summary: Configured node1 (10.100.64.10) as the cluster's internal chrony time source (local stratum 10 fallback, NTP allowed for 10.100.64.0/24, firewall opened for the ntp service) and configured node2 to sync solely against node1 (server 10.100.64.10 iburst, public pool servers removed). Verified node2 selected node1 as its active source (^*, Reference ID 0A64400A) and node1 lists node2 as an NTP client. Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on both nodes: captured pre-restart boot IDs, issued native reboots, polled until each node was reachable again, confirmed changed boot IDs, and verified chronyd was active with correct config and (for node2) re-established sync to node1 afterward.
